questions.q: You are supervising the installation of a steam-driven reciprocating pump. The pump's air chamber is missing and you have to replace it with one from several salvaged ones. The salvaged air chamber selected should have a volume equal to, most nearly:
options: Half of the piston displacement of the pump
1 1/2 times the piston displacement of the pump
2 times the piston displacement of the pump
2 1/2 times the piston displacement of the pump
questions.answer: 2 1/2 times the piston displacement of the pump
